Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/5/59/Sk_aa_dm3-docsnyder.qwd DocSnyder (SK)]

"The match was played on UK-server Sara, and seemed to provide reasonable pings for both teams, SK using it's two Swedish and one of it's UK-players for the match. As I remember, the start was fairly even with both teams landing a few early blows but neither taking any real advantage. With the second or third quad though, things began to swing SK's way and soon enough they had control and were just racking in the frags. Nice coverage of the spawns by SK. / ego" === DM3-2 === SK: 198 - AA: 40
[[Image:Sk aa dm3-2.gif]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/2/21/Sk_aa_dm3_2-docsnyder.qwd DocSnyder (SK)]

"Second round, also on Sara and also on DM3. This match went slightly better for AA as Max Rebo managed to make a break and do a very nice gib-run by the Red Armor around mid-game.
